notes: The Ice dungeon is snow, frost and stone gone blue. The set is built from the A-grade winter spires and snow crags, with a frozen hearth and a white pelt, and the Frostspire Ring as the showpiece. There is no extremely rare ice piece, so the boss is a rare; Ice Spire is held by the ice-elemental Nemesis trophy.

entries.why: Lumpy snow drift against a doorway.
Snow-white fur pelt from the far north.
Tall jagged spires of frozen snow.
Frozen hollow of arched snow crags.
Frostspire Ring, four towering spires around a ring.
